source_read: https://fathippo.co.uk/menus/food/, /menus/drinks/, /menus/kids/, /menus/special-menu/ (all four downloaded fresh 2026-10-08, byte-identical to the 15:38 copy the committed data was built from)
not_verifiable: allergens: none are published for this chain (guide link only: the page's nut notice is undecided and 7 dishes have a part with no allergen statement), so none were compared
notes: An independent regex parse of all 134 panels (per 1 serving, 8 nutrients) matched every one of the 131 rows in items.csv (100 published plus the held-back ones) by title and numbers; the script re-run on the fresh pages reproduces data/source exactly. Earlier-run holdbacks (31) kept. Added this session: Handcut Fries side (113 kcal, 0 g fat vs 424 kcal, 14 g fat for the same fries as upgrade and kids' portion: contradicts itself), and two food rows whose kcal equals the sum of their listed parts but whose macros are 17-18% off (Freddies Fingers: Buffalo, Dirty Tater Tots upgrade) under a new 15% food rule; drinks keep the 25% rule because alcohol and organic acids add energy (Kids and Pint Orange Cordial, Apple Fruit Juice stay with a warning). The two hard shakes are marked ok (part kcal equal the panel; alcohol energy).
